_doc: T4-CE slice 1: machine-checked field-watch registry — the single home for watch definitions.
Each entry: id, ticket (owner), description, type, patterns. The evaluator (watch_report.py)
runs every entry against a preflight corpus and emits one verdict line per watch.
type=watch verdicts: FIRED(n) — the fired pattern matched n times (the check note says what
a session should confirm by eye); OPPORTUNITY-NO-FIRE(n) — the opportunity pattern matched
but the mechanism never fired (needs attention); NO-OPPORTUNITY — neither matched;
NOT-OBSERVED — no opportunity pattern is defined and the mechanism did not fire.
type=tally verdicts: COUNT(n) — a metric, not a pass/fail.
summary=summary.txt. Patterns are Python regexes matched against the raw file text
Lifecycle: a watch whose firing has been confirmed by a session gets REMOVED here and its
closure recorded on the owning ticket — the registry holds OPEN watches only.

watches.description: first live system_resumed after a breaker episode
watches.check: the resume must follow a breaker episode and cycles must continue after it

watches.description: first decisive gate acceptance on a gate-refusal loop

goal_status_changed events present (first field validation of the v2 stream)
